title: Venezuela’s top opposition leader claims ‘new era’ is coming despite lack of clear plan
summary: María Corina Machado pens a ‘freedom manifesto’ as plan to force Nicolás Maduro from power remains unclearVenezuela’s top opposition leader, the Nobel laureate María Corina Machado, has declared her country “at the edge of a new era” as Donald Trump refused to rule out a ground invasion to topple its authoritarian leader, Nicolás Maduro, but also signalled he was open to talks.Machado, who has lived in hiding since her movement’s candidate was widely believed to have beaten Maduro in last year’s presidential election, made her claim in a“freedom manifesto”that was published on Tuesday as uncertainty continued to shroud the South American country’s future.Continue reading...
